title: AGENTS.md#Default to background-subagent dispatch chunk 2
summary: Decompose into native tasks (TaskCreate) and register them in the orchestrator graph. After creating a task, call suggest_links and add context/blocking edges so it wires into existing/completed work instead of becoming an orphan root node. Ask Subconscious for the routine assignment surface (subconscious_assignment prepare), then dispatch the actual work to a background subagent (Agent tool, run_in_background: true) that accepts the assignment (subconscious_assignment accept) and reports back (subconscious_assignment complete). Keep the main thread free to orchestrate and talk to the user — never block it on a build.
